name: Droost Playbook
description: Declares the Droost site-building methodology to AI agents: SDC as the universal display substrate, the tool flows to follow, and worked examples — as served guideline topics.
project_description: Droost Playbook declares the Droost site-building methodology to AI agents as served guideline topics: SDC (Single Directory Components) as the universal display substrate, the Droost tool flows to follow, and worked examples. It is pure content — two on-demand topics (guidelines/topics/methodology.md and guidelines/topics/theming.md) that the base module's GuidelineProvider discovers and the droost_guidelines MCP tool serves to agents; the topics also appear in the AGENTS.md block that drush droost:install writes. The module ships no PHP src, routes, permissions, config or Drush; it depends only on droost and carries only a kernel test verifying the topics are served. Enable it on sites built the Droost way; the droost_cms recipe enables it by default. Local development only.
